comment: The maker's documentation says the spread count "can range from 2 to 16" and writes the menu item as "Add CV expander". SpreadMerge.cpp:41 configures the button as Maximize plus the fixed counts 2 to 8, and SpreadMerge.cpp:154 creates the menu item as "Add CV Expander"; a block of more than 8 is reached only through Maximize with a single input patched. SpreadMerge.cpp:73 finds the highest patched gate and treats every pair above it as in use, so an unpatched pair below a patched one still consumes its block of channels; the documentation does not mention this.
